milestones.title: CircuitVision website
milestones.detail: The original frontend and FastAPI API are deployed on Render. Image upload and webcam detection have passed automated API smoke tests.

milestones.title: Live YOLO detection
milestones.detail: The production live camera uses the team's Round 2 YOLO11n detector and browser motion tracking. Android camera quality and moving-object accuracy still require hands-on validation.

milestones.title: Photo detection expansion
milestones.detail: Still images use the team-trained core model, with optional additional Round 3 predictions. Small-object tiling is enabled for large photographs.

milestones.title: Sam's detailed component recognition
milestones.detail: Ten specialist classes and fusion logic are prepared; the verified specialist ONNX checkpoint has not yet been installed on the hosted service.

milestones.title: One jointly trained YOLO11 model
milestones.detail: The Google Colab notebook prepares three training stages (35, 25, 15 epochs) for a proposed 87-class detector. No new model has yet been validated for production.

milestones.title: Real laboratory evaluation
milestones.detail: Independent tests of detection errors, bounding-box stability, resistor-value visual hints and performance on Android/Windows are still needed.

recent_updates.title: Progress-update safeguards tested
recent_updates.detail: GitHub checks require feature changes to review public status; milestones can advance once actual model evidence becomes available.

recent_updates.title: Project progress is now shown on the About page
recent_updates.detail: A versioned project status and live deployment/model details distinguish completed work from testing and planned work.

recent_updates.title: Website wording and mobile layout reviewed
recent_updates.detail: Removed outdated EESOB-era claims and corrected oversized workflow panels and horizontal overflow.

recent_updates.title: Detection workflow updated
recent_updates.detail: Added still-image small-object tiling, safe optional specialist integration, and browser-tracking safeguards without claiming new measured accuracy.

limitations: YOLO labels, confidence scores and bounding boxes are predictions, not proof of per-class accuracy or electrical measurements. Exact resistor resistance must be checked from markings or with suitable measurement equipment.
